title: Design tokens v2 and shared Vati Workspace component kit
scope: Replace the shared tokens with the v2 contract and build the shared components once (header, app rail and sidebar, page header, notices, table toolbar, data table, usage line, key-facts strip, routed tabs, drawer, dialog, status chip, empty state, skeleton, toast, command palette) on frappe-ui, used by both apps

acceptance.text: apps/shared/design tokens implement the v2 colour, type, spacing, radius and status values with measured WCAG AA contrast for every text/background pair used
Each shared component exists once, is used by both apps where relevant and appears in the rebuilt showcase in normal, hover, focus, disabled, loading, empty and error states
No Cloudflare or Zoho logo, colour, illustration or copy is used; patterns only (ADR-044); the stack stays Vue 3 + frappe-ui

Screenshots at 1440, 1024 and 390px with loading, empty, error and denied states, keyboard/focus and axe results, and the TAX-144 page-length result; record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Component tests, showcase screenshots and axe

evidence.text: apps/shared/design/tokens.css implements the v2 contract from DESIGN_STANDARD.md: neutral canvas #f7f8fa, surfaces, #e4e7ec dividers, #101828 text, #475467 supporting text; one accent #1d4ed8 (hover #1e40af); info/success/warning/danger/neutral text, background and border triples; optional dark navigation panel #111827/#e5e7eb; type scale 12/13/14/16/20/24/30 and weights 400/500/600; spacing 4-48px; radii 6/8px; overlay-only shadow; shell dimensions. Contrast is measured: scripts/check_contrast.py resolves the tokens and checks all 24 text/background and UI pairs the kit uses (apps/shared/design/contrast-pairs.json); all pass WCAG AA, lowest text pair 5.4:1 (success). tests/tooling/test_contrast.py (run by dev.py check) fails if any pair drops below 4.5:1 (text) or 3:1 (UI). Table in docs/evidence/TAX-145/README.md.

apps/shared/components holds each component once: WorkspaceHeader, AppSidebar (rail and dark variants), PageHeader, NoticePanel (recommendations), TableToolbar, DataTable (sticky header, sort with aria-sort, column info, empty dash, row action, 25-row pagination, loading/empty/error), UsageLine, KeyFacts, RoutedTabs, SideDrawer, ConfirmDialog, StatusChip, EmptyState, SkeletonBlock, InlineError, notify() toast, CommandPalette (Ctrl K / Cmd K). Both apps compile them (shared paths in each tsconfig and Tailwind content). Used in both apps: the auditor PageLayout and the taxpayer PortalHeader render the shared PageHeader; the taxpayer evidence-request and My cases empty states use EmptyState. The showcase (KitShowcase.vue) shows every component with disabled, loading, empty and error states; hover and focus are shown by use and in the keyboard screenshot. Behaviour tests: apps/auditor-web/src/components/kit.test.ts (sorting, empty values last, pagination, named row action, states, notice collapse/dismiss, sidebar rail, header, drawer dialog, palette keyboard).

No Cloudflare or Zoho logo, colour, illustration, icon artwork or copy: grep for cloudflare|zoho|kumo over apps/shared, apps/auditor-web/src and apps/taxpayer-web/src finds 0 matches; colours come only from tokens.css. The stack stays Vue 3 + frappe-ui; reka-ui 2.11.0, the primitive library frappe-ui 1.1.0 already installs, is now declared explicitly for the drawer, popover and palette dialogs (one-line package-lock change, no new download).

Screenshots at 1440, 1024 and 390 (Chromium) in docs/evidence/TAX-145: the whole kit, table keyboard focus, drawer, confirmation dialog, command palette, taxpayer empty state and denied state. tests/frontend/kit.spec.ts (19 passed at three widths): axe clean on the showcase and with each overlay open, no page-wide horizontal scroll, drawer focus trap/Escape/focus return, sort by keyboard, palette by keyboard. TAX-144 page length at 1440x900: My cases 1.0, Evidence requests 1.0 (budget 1.5); showcase 6.17, exempt. Also run: npm run check (lint, format, both typechecks, auditor vitest 129, taxpayer vitest 77, both builds) passed; dev.py check passed; ruff check, ruff format (touched files) and mypy passed; tests/frontend auditor, taxpayer, layout, responses, claim and reminders specs passed at three widths; apps/auditor-web e2e 66 passed (including showcase axe and 320px reflow).
